day_note: Day 5, 00:07 JST fire. NEW since the 20:07 STATE write: the owner gate on H1 Coconala CHANGED. PG-1 standing submit-permission LANDED (owner granted it 10/04; decision PG-1 recorded) — so mac-local ran the H1 scan at 22:20 JST 10/04 and tried to apply to 5303405 (¥8,000/3d, 92 applicants/0 contracts, closes 10/12). That is identity verification (Art.9 / PG-1 cond.7), so only the owner can clear it (~2 min). mac-local filed task owner-coconala-sms-auth (P1) and OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED.md top (10/04 22:21) with the exact 1-step ask; then ran its own E2 stop_screen + session_end (every mac-local motion gated on SMS). So the owner ask is now SMALLER and FASTER than before (one SMS auth, not a permission grant), and the moment it clears mac-local auto-sends the ready 5303405 draft under PG-1. Re-ranked priority_actions #1 to the SMS ask; added it to human_queue.open (STATE previously showed open:[] and rank-1 'proposal-permission' — both now stale, corrected this fire). Fresh reads this fire: Stripe livemode 0 charges / 0 payment_intents (G1 unmet; even the 3 Sept cs_live no longer surface as charges/PIs). X queue validates & is stocked to the Day-8 horizon (小ネタ①-④ am 10/05-10/08 + Day5 numbers 10/05 pm); Day4 numbers post live (tweet 2106597528544116781).
